name: goldband-local-extension
description: Claude Desktop extension for the local goldband first-party MCP server.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a local goldband checkout through the first-party read-only goldband MCP server. This is a Claude app adapter and does not install Claude Code hooks or settings.
